title: two-aircraft formation sharing personnel

resource_policy.pool: one site-level P-CREW pool shared by both aircraft
resource_policy.queue: when both requests occur together, either aircraft may be granted first; the observed native tie-break must be recorded and remain stable on replay
resource_policy.release: release at each aircraft preparation completion
resource_policy.formation_gate: launch only after both aircraft preparations complete

native_mapping.mapping_gate: ResourceAllocation.POINT must equal Control.APID (AIR_BASIC); prove that one ResourceAllocation row is a shared pool for both selected aircraft; per-aircraft duplicate supply is forbidden

observability.acceptance_gate: each assertion that depends on an unconfirmed field remains unverified until raw ENLOG/report output exposes it or a controlled capacity intervention uniquely distinguishes it
observability.derived_evidence_rule: a reconstructed ledger must be labeled derived, cite raw rows/events and cannot replace missing owner-level native evidence
observability.failure_rule: if staffing 2/1/0 changes launch time but request, wait, ownership or release cannot be observed, accept only the bounded launch-delay behavior and keep the resource-transaction assertions blocked

variants.cancellation_scope: 510 is accepted only as the observed result of this fixed profile; the general deadline rule remains C04
